To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose a novel off-policy estimation method for infinite-horizon reinforcement learning that is asymptotically consistent and achieves finite-sample performance comparable to existing methods, without requiring data to be collected by a known policy.

(1) we formulate off-policy estimation in infinite horizon problems as solving a fixed point of a backward flow operator; (2) the solution gives importance ratios of stationary distribution between the target policy and behavior policy; (3) we prove the asymptotic consistency of our approach and provide a finite-sample error bound.

(1) the proposed approach is consistent and asymptotically normal, (2) it is more efficient than the previous approach, (3) it does not require knowing the behavior policy, and (4) it is easy to implement and can be applied to a variety of problems.
